newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares rise on Reliance bonus rumour.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares rise on Reliance bonus rumour.

text.p: Delhi shares opened higher in brisk trade on Thursday on steady buying by financial institutions and speculators, spurred by persistent rumours of an impending bonus issue by Reliance Industries, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was up 5.60 points at 826.02 after 30 minutes of trade.
Reliance gained two rupees, rising to 319.
"It seems the market has entered a bull phase on huge purchases by institutional investors in index-based stocks," said Ashok Kaul of brokers Rajpaul Chadha and Co.
Larsen and Toubro rose 3.05 rupees to 231.50 on buying by domestic investors.
Bajaj Auto traded 1.95 rupees higher at 877.
